name: Via Claudia Camping
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Via Claudia Camping is located in Lechbruck am See in Tirol, Austria, in a scenically shaped environment between mountains and lakes. The campsite offers pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as basic infrastructure with sanitary facilities and supply options. The atmosphere on the site is quiet and connected to nature, characterized by the alpine surroundings and the proximity to Lake Lechbruck. In the surrounding area, and mountain bike routes are available, making it easy to access the surrounding mountains. Guests can also find opportunities for winter sports activities in the region, as ski resorts are within reach. The location is ideal as a starting point for excursions to the Allgäuer Alpen and the adjacent Tiroler mountain world. The site caters to camping guests who prefer nature-based accommodation with a simple standard.
